quotes.text:
// To make sure it isn't just the backing real folder that's displayed for
    // some reason, really search for something.
// Select a group header to test for bug 1924728.
// Selections for group headers should not be persisted.

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The current grouping test uses a real date search criterion when constructing both virtual folders. Its comment explains that this prevents an accidentally displayed backing folder from passing the test. A newer regression case selects a synthetic group header before leaving grouping and checks that the selection becomes -1, because a group header is not a persistent message selection. Manual test proposal for virtual lists: make fixtures exercise search behavior and cover synthetic-row selection during view changes. These are current added tests; they do not prove every virtual-folder path or platform. The test has explicit platform/debug skips.
title: Virtual-folder tests must distinguish searched data from backing-folder display
